svg.title: k8s-secops-platform hybrid Kubernetes architecture
svg.desc: A kubeadm cluster on one home Wi-Fi LAN. The control plane is a Hyper-V VM on the Windows desktop, running etcd, the API server, the scheduler, and the controller manager. The data plane is two bare-metal laptops, each running the kubelet, containerd, the Cilium agent, and a Longhorn replica; the replicas sync over Wi-Fi. The admin manages the cluster from the desktop. A Cilium Gateway at 10.0.0.56 serves HTTPS to the admin desktop only. Cilium provides the eBPF dataplane and a cluster-wide default deny. Nodes reach the internet through the home router. Wazuh, its agents, and Argo CD are planned.
svg.text: Hybrid kubeadm lab · v1.37.1 · Cilium 1.20.2 · Rocky Linux 10.2, CIS-hardened, SELinux enforcing · observed 2026-10-27
Home LAN · 10.0.0.0/24 · Wi-Fi · one flat subnet, no NAT between nodes
control-plane-1 · Hyper-V VM on the Windows desktop
2 vCPU · 8 GiB · static pods run as spc_t
control-plane taint keeps app workloads off;
also runs a CoreDNS replica and the Cilium agent
Hyper-V checkpoints off · back up etcd
bare-metal laptops · LUKS disks · lid ignored · sleep masked
Cilium 1.20.2 · eBPF dataplane · kube-proxy replacement · Hubble flow visibility
cluster-wide default deny · per-namespace allow policies · L2 announcements for LAN addresses
HTTPS to the Gateway, desktop only
